dialogues.speaker: Shoutarou
dialogues.jp: 「ではこの間の試験を返しましょう」
dialogues.en: "Well then, I'd return your exam papers now."
dialogues.text: "Well then, I'd return your exam papers now."

dialogues.jp: その声にクラスがざわつく。
dialogues.en: The class erupted with noise and worry following his words.
dialogues.text: The class erupted with noise and worry following his words.

dialogues.jp: いつもなら、俺もその中のひとりなのだが……。
dialogues.en: Surprisingly, I was the odd one out.
dialogues.text: Surprisingly, I was the odd one out.

dialogues.jp: （今回は結構良かったからな）
dialogues.en: "(I think I did well for this one.)"
dialogues.text: "(I think I did well for this one.)"

dialogues.jp:
落ち着いた気分で、クラスのざわめきを傍観す
る。
dialogues.en:
I looked at the bustling scenes before me with an odd sense
of calmness.
dialogues.text:
I looked at the bustling scenes before me with an odd sense
of calmness.

dialogues.speaker: Shoutarou
dialogues.jp: 「では出席番号順に前にとりに来て下さい」
dialogues.en:
"I'd call your names by attendance number, please come
forward to collect your paper when you are called."
dialogues.text:
"I'd call your names by attendance number, please come
forward to collect your paper when you are called."

dialogues.jp: その声に、俺は腰をあげる。
dialogues.en: At his call, I got moving.
dialogues.text: At his call, I got moving.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほう、今回はなかなかいい点ではないか朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Ooh, this time you actually got good grades, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ooh, this time you actually got good grades, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "I guess."
dialogues.text: "I guess."

dialogues.jp:
俺のテスト用紙に目を向けていた杉並が、顔を
あげて呟く。
dialogues.en:
Reading my test paper over my shoulder, I could hear
Suginami's muttering.
dialogues.text:
Reading my test paper over my shoulder, I could hear
Suginami's muttering.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どれどれ？」
dialogues.en: "What's going on?"
dialogues.text: "What's going on?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並の声に、斜め前の席の眞子が席を立って、
杉並の手にあるテスト用紙を覗く。
dialogues.en:
Attracted by Suginami's voice, Mako went up to my desk as
well. Suginami handed her my exam paper.
dialogues.text:
Attracted by Suginami's voice, Mako went up to my desk as
well. Suginami handed her my exam paper.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うそ！？　これ朝倉の？」
dialogues.en: "No way!? This is Asakura's?"
dialogues.text: "No way!? This is Asakura's?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「杉並のじゃなくて？」
dialogues.en: "Not Suginami's?"
dialogues.text: "Not Suginami's?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺の文字はもっと美しい」
dialogues.en: "My handwriting is far more elegant."
dialogues.text: "My handwriting is far more elegant."

dialogues.jp: 何に抗議しているんだ。
dialogues.en:
I felt like I should protest, but I couldn't phrase it
somehow.
dialogues.text:
I felt like I should protest, but I couldn't phrase it
somehow.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ……すごいじゃん朝倉」
dialogues.en: "He-eh... pretty good, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "He-eh... pretty good, Asakura."

dialogues.jp: 眞子は素直に感心している。
dialogues.en: Mako complimented me rather unaffectedly.
dialogues.text: Mako complimented me rather unaffectedly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いったいどんなトリックを使ったのか――実
　に興味深い」
dialogues.en:
"I'm really interested though-- Just what kind of trick did
you use."
dialogues.text:
"I'm really interested though-- Just what kind of trick did
you use."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「実力だっての」
dialogues.en: "T'is my true potential."
dialogues.text: "T'is my true potential."

dialogues.jp: まあ、冗談だというのは分かっているが。
dialogues.en: Even I could tell I was joking there.
dialogues.text: Even I could tell I was joking there.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「でもホントすごいじゃん朝倉。見直したよ」
dialogues.en:
"But that really is great, Asakura. You've gone up in my
view."
dialogues.text:
"But that really is great, Asakura. You've gone up in my
view."

dialogues.jp: こっちが照れるぐらい、心底感心している。
dialogues.en:
I started feeling self-concious from the earnest compliment
I'd just received.
dialogues.text:
I started feeling self-concious from the earnest compliment
I'd just received.

dialogues.jp:
（他人のことなのに、自分のことのように喜ん
　でくれるのが、こいつのいいところだよな）
dialogues.en:
"(In a way, I bet she cares more about others that she does
herself.)"
dialogues.text:
"(In a way, I bet she cares more about others that she does
herself.)"

dialogues.jp: ホントいいやつだ。
dialogues.en: She's really a good person.
dialogues.text: She's really a good person.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What."
dialogues.text: "What."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「別に。なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Nothing, forget about it."
dialogues.text: "Nothing, forget about it."

dialogues.jp:
最後にまた笑顔で誉めたあと、眞子は自分の席
に戻っていった。
dialogues.en:
She left my table, showing me a admiring smile before
returning to her desk.
dialogues.text:
She left my table, showing me a admiring smile before
returning to her desk.

dialogues.jp:
杉並からテスト用紙を受け取りながら、俺はそ
の横顔をなんとなく見つづけていた。
dialogues.en:
Suginami returned my exam paper back to me, and I tried to
avoid looking at Mako's face again.
dialogues.text:
Suginami returned my exam paper back to me, and I tried to
avoid looking at Mako's face again.

dialogues.jp: ◆意外にいい、試験の結果◆
dialogues.en: ◆An Unexpectedly Good Exam Result◆
dialogues.text: ◆An Unexpectedly Good Exam Result◆

dialogues.jp:
試験のテストが返された。いつもなら｛おび／怯｝えると
ころだが、今回は自信があるぞ。
dialogues.en:
Exam papers were returned. Although I'm usually white with
fear in that propsect, this time I was full of confidence.
dialogues.text:
Exam papers were returned. Although I'm usually white with
fear in that propsect, this time I was full of confidence.

dialogues.jp:
予想通りそれなりにいい点で、眞子なんかはし
きりに感心していた。
dialogues.en:
Just as I forecasted, I got excellent grades, and Mako
complimented me a lot for it.
dialogues.text:
Just as I forecasted, I got excellent grades, and Mako
complimented me a lot for it.

dialogues.jp: 他人の事なのに、自分の事のように喜ぶ。
dialogues.en: She cares more about others than she does her own matters.
dialogues.text: She cares more about others than she does her own matters.

dialogues.jp: ほんと、いい奴だよな、こいつって。
dialogues.en: She's really a good person.
dialogues.text: She's really a good person.
